1//! Page information segment parsing (7.4.8).
2
3use crate::third_party::hayro_jbig2::decode::CombinationOperator;
4use crate::third_party::hayro_jbig2::error::{ParseError, Result};
5use crate::third_party::hayro_jbig2::reader::Reader;
6
7/// Parsed page information segment (7.4.8).
8#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default)]
9pub(crate) struct PageInformation {
10    /// "This is a four-byte value containing the width in pixels of the page's
11    /// bitmap." (7.4.8.1)
12    pub(crate) width: u32,
13    /// "This is a four-byte value containing the height in pixels of the page's
14    /// bitmap." (7.4.8.2)
15    pub(crate) height: u32,
16    /// "This is a four-byte value containing the resolution of the original page
17    /// medium, measured in pixels/metre in the horizontal direction. If this
18    /// value is unknown, then this field must contain 0x00000000." (7.4.8.3)
19    ///
20    /// `None` means unknown resolution.
21    pub(crate) _x_resolution: Option<u32>,
22    /// "This is a four-byte value containing the resolution of the original page
23    /// medium, measured in pixels/metre in the vertical direction. If this value
24    /// is unknown, then this field must contain 0x00000000." (7.4.8.4)
25    ///
26    /// `None` means unknown resolution.
27    pub(crate) _y_resolution: Option<u32>,
28    /// Page segment flags (7.4.8.5).
29    pub(crate) flags: PageFlags,
30    /// Page striping information (7.4.8.6).
31    pub(crate) _striping: PageStriping,
32}
33
34/// Page segment flags (7.4.8.5, Figure 56).
35#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
36#[allow(unused)]
37#[derive(Default)]
38pub(crate) struct PageFlags {
39    /// "Bit 0: Page is eventually lossless. If this bit is 0, then the file does
40    /// not contain a lossless representation of the original (pre-coding) page.
41    /// If this bit is 1, then the file contains enough information to reconstruct
42    /// the original page." (7.4.8.5)
43    pub(crate) is_lossless: bool,
44    /// "Bit 1: Page might contain refinements. If this bit is 0, then no
45    /// refinement region segment may be associated with the page. If this bit
46    /// is 1, then such segments may be associated with the page." (7.4.8.5)
47    pub(crate) might_contain_refinements: bool,
48    /// "Bit 2: Page default pixel value. This bit contains the initial value for
49    /// every pixel in the page, before any region segments are decoded or drawn."
50    /// (7.4.8.5)
51    pub(crate) default_pixel: u8,
52    /// "Bits 3-4: Page default combination operator." (7.4.8.5)
53    pub(crate) default_combination_operator: CombinationOperator,
54    /// "Bit 5: Page requires auxiliary buffers. If this bit is 0, then no region
55    /// segment requiring an auxiliary buffer may be associated with the page."
56    /// (7.4.8.5)
57    pub(crate) requires_auxiliary_buffers: bool,
58    /// "Bit 6: Page combination operator overridden. If this bit is 0, then every
59    /// direct region segment associated with this page must use the page's default
60    /// combination operator. If this bit is 1, then direct region segments
61    /// associated with this page may use any combination operators." (7.4.8.5)
62    pub(crate) combination_operator_overridden: bool,
63    /// "Bit 7: Page might contain coloured segment. If this bit is 0, then no
64    /// segment with colour extension may be associated with the page." (7.4.8.5)
65    pub(crate) might_contain_coloured: bool,
66}
67
68/// Page striping information (7.4.8.6, Figure 57).
69#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default)]
70pub(crate) struct PageStriping {
71    /// "Bit 15: Page is striped. If the 'page is striped' bit is 1, then the page
72    /// may have end of stripe segments associated with it." (7.4.8.6)
73    ///
74    /// "If the page's bitmap height is unknown (indicated by a page bitmap height
75    /// of 0xFFFFFFFF) then the 'page is striped' bit must be 1." (7.4.8.6)
76    pub(crate) _is_striped: bool,
77    /// "Bits 0-14: Maximum stripe size." (7.4.8.6)
78    ///
79    /// "The maximum size of each stripe (the distance between an end of stripe
80    /// segment's end row and the end row of the previous end of stripe segment,
81    /// or 0 in the case of the first end of stripe segment) must be no more than
82    /// the page's maximum stripe size." (7.4.8.6)
83    pub(crate) _max_stripe_size: u16,
84}
85
86/// Parse a page information segment (7.4.8).
87pub(crate) fn parse_page_information(reader: &mut Reader<'_>) -> Result<PageInformation> {
88    // 7.4.8.1: Page bitmap width
89    let width = reader.read_u32().ok_or(ParseError::UnexpectedEof)?;
90
91    // 7.4.8.2: Page bitmap height
92    let height = reader.read_u32().ok_or(ParseError::UnexpectedEof)?;
93
94    // 7.4.8.3: Page X resolution
95    let x_resolution_raw = reader.read_u32().ok_or(ParseError::UnexpectedEof)?;
96    let x_resolution = if x_resolution_raw == 0 { None } else { Some(x_resolution_raw) };
97
98    // 7.4.8.4: Page Y resolution
99    let y_resolution_raw = reader.read_u32().ok_or(ParseError::UnexpectedEof)?;
100    let y_resolution = if y_resolution_raw == 0 { None } else { Some(y_resolution_raw) };
101
102    // 7.4.8.5: Page segment flags
103    let flags_byte = reader.read_byte().ok_or(ParseError::UnexpectedEof)?;
104    let flags = parse_page_flags(flags_byte);
105
106    // 7.4.8.6: Page striping information
107    let striping_raw = reader.read_u16().ok_or(ParseError::UnexpectedEof)?;
108    let striping = PageStriping { _is_striped: striping_raw & 0x8000 != 0, _max_stripe_size: striping_raw & 0x7FFF };
109
110    Ok(PageInformation { width, height, _x_resolution: x_resolution, _y_resolution: y_resolution, flags, _striping: striping })
111}
112
113fn parse_page_flags(flags: u8) -> PageFlags {
114    let combo_bits = (flags >> 3) & 0x03;
115    let default_combination_operator = match combo_bits {
116        0 => CombinationOperator::Or,
117        1 => CombinationOperator::And,
118        2 => CombinationOperator::Xor,
119        3 => CombinationOperator::Xnor,
120        _ => unreachable!(),
121    };
122
123    PageFlags {
124        is_lossless: flags & 0x01 != 0,
125        might_contain_refinements: flags & 0x02 != 0,
126        default_pixel: (flags >> 2) & 0x01,
127        default_combination_operator,
128        requires_auxiliary_buffers: flags & 0x20 != 0,
129        combination_operator_overridden: flags & 0x40 != 0,
130        might_contain_coloured: flags & 0x80 != 0,
131    }
132}
